description: Aptos adapter for Crypto.Net: ed25519 accounts (SLIP-10 m/44'/637'), AIP-40 addresses, Move type tags, BCS entry-function transactions, simulation and a REST client.

Cardano adapter for Crypto.Net: CIP-1852 accounts with BIP32-Ed25519 (Icarus) keys, base/enterprise/reward addresses, Conway transactions with native assets and CIP-20 messages, exact fees and UTxO selection, and a Koios client.

Source generators for Crypto.Net: Solidity ABI JSON (*.abi.json, Hardhat/Foundry artifacts) becomes a typed EvmContract client, and Anchor IDL (*.idl.json) becomes a Solana instruction/account client. The same code generator powers `cnet gen`.

Blockchain indexing for Crypto.Net: EVM log indexer with ABI event decoding, a generic block crawler, resumable checkpoints, reorg-safe confirmation depth and adaptive range sizing, plus hosted-service integration.

Entity Framework Core storage for Crypto.Net.Indexer: checkpoints, raw EVM logs and ERC-20 transfers with idempotent writes. Works with SQLite, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and any relational EF Core provider.

Ledger hardware wallet support for Crypto.Net: APDU protocol, USB HID and Speculos (TCP) transports, the Ethereum app (addresses, transactions, personal messages, EIP-712) and the Solana app (addresses, transactions, off-chain messages). Keys never leave the device.
NEAR Protocol adapter for Crypto.Net: ed25519 keys (SLIP-10 m/44'/397'), implicit and named accounts, Borsh transactions with every action, function calls, access keys and a JSON-RPC client.

Sui adapter for Crypto.Net: ed25519 accounts (SLIP-10 m/44'/784'), suiprivkey import/export, programmable transaction blocks (BCS build and parse), intent signing, personal messages and a GraphQL client.

TON adapter for Crypto.Net: cells and bags of cells, raw and user-friendly addresses, TON mnemonics, wallet contracts V4R2 and W5 (V5R1), transfers with comments, jetton transfers and a TON Center client.

Trezor hardware wallet support for Crypto.Net: protocol v1 framing, Trezor Bridge and emulator (UDP) transports, and Ethereum/EVM addresses, legacy and EIP-1559 transactions, personal messages and EIP-712 hashes. Keys never leave the device.

WalletConnect v2 (Reown) for Crypto.Net: pair with mobile wallets through the relay, propose and approve sessions, send EIP-155 requests (personal_sign, eth_signTypedData_v4, eth_sendTransaction), and build wallets that answer them.

A high-performance .NET library for the Windows Recycle Bin: move files and directories into it, list what is in it, restore entries, empty it, and report the outcome of every item. It reads and writes the Recycle Bin's own files — no SHFileOperation, no IFileOperation, no COM.
Shared contracts and attributes used by ButterMorph generated code and host services.
Language adapter contracts, type mapping documents, and code generation models for ButterMorph.
Official C# language adapter for ButterMorph code generation and type mappings.

Value Object UnidadDeMedida para el ERP Cosmos: código UN/ECE Rec. 20 con catálogo embebido de 1.095 unidades (las que admiten las facturas electrónicas de Colombia, República Dominicana y Panamá) y traducción desde el código de unidad de cada autoridad. Diseñado para eventos event-sourced.
